mentions.name: Belgian parliament tracker
mentions.description: A tracker for the Belgian parliament with a daily scraper/parser that transforms published data into parquet files, an LLM summarizer for larger discussions, and an automatically generated static site providing insight into votes and discussions.
mentions.problem: The Belgian parliament has a very old website and publishes most data, including votes and discussions, as a weekly PDF report.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on a tracker for the Belgian parliament [0]. Similar story: very old site + data mostly gets published as a weekly pdf report (including votes and discussions).
